sentences.en: He wrote a letter of inquiry to his business contact.
sentences.zh: 他给他的业务联系人写了一封询问信。

sentences.en: We have just received an inquiry from Kansas concerning your brother.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚收到了来自堪萨斯州关于你哥哥的询问。

sentences.en: This subject is outside the scope of our inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这个主题超出了我们调查的范围。
